parsed.name: Cytomat 样品自动转运与孵育工作站
parsed.name_en: Cytomat automated storage and incubation workcell
parsed.description: 用于样品/板架的自动存取与转运的孵育工作站，具备温度、CO₂、O₂、湿度等孵育环境控制，以及震荡装置、舱门与内部转运/滑铲机构，可在存储位、等待位与外部暴露位之间进行板/托盘搬运，并可读取存储位置条码。
parsed.description_en: An automated incubation and storage workcell for plates/samples. It provides incubation control (temperature, CO₂, O₂, humidity), includes shaking capability, and uses an internal door plus transfer/shovel mechanisms to move plates between storage, waiting, and exposed positions, with barcode reading for storage locations.
